maintained_source_delta.description: After these runs, a native device comment removes an unsupported replay-safety claim. The common CLI failure-record exception handler is corrected separately with CPU regressions. No native executable statement changed.

common_cli_failure_record.description: After the B200 runs, only the common CLI exception handler and two CPU regressions changed. A secondary failure-record write error retains the original failure or skip reason and exit code. The happy path, native invocation, common native helper and all native executable statements remain unchanged.

limits: Single-host two-GPU diagnostic, not canonical performance qualification.
No multi-node, IBGDA, NCCL GIN or CFT validation.
All device user kernels use one CTA per PE.
Python stencil dump checks reconstruct periodic halo rows. Native verification separately checks received halos.
Historical unprofiled timings remain separate from these intrusive profile captures.
Older raw captures remain private because they contain operational metadata. New assets require their own exact-byte privacy audit.

The original MPI and host NVSHMEM cases in jobs 1141–1143 use thin partitions with no nonempty interior launch. A separate later record covers their nonempty-interior correctness cases. Those backends still have no retained timeline proving GPU overlap.
review_status: Scoped review receipts are retained separately. This diagnostic record is not a publication-readiness verdict.

privacy_audit.disclosure: The static MPI vendor package build signature and actual GPU UUID fields remain in native captures. They are distinct from the synthetic namespace hostname and machine identity. No original operational host identifiers, credential assignments or private workspace paths were found in the audited assets.
privacy_audit.scope: Exact phase1142/1143 assets plus scheduler and analysis supplements. Earlier smoke prototype has a separate exact-byte audit.

source_snapshot_scope: File inventory at the GPU-executed source commit. Presence here records source bytes and does not prove that each listed file ran. Native build receipts, per-case arguments and wrapper records identify the executed paths.
metadata_notes: Raw MPI library-version strings contain a trailing NUL from the retained implementation output. Original JSON and reports are preserved. Curated environment fields name the implementation separately.

The repository profile_rank.sh selector was exercised in historical job 1138. Fresh job 1143 used the collector-generated selected-rank.sh. Their duration, replay and warmup flags agree by inspection. The collection sources and per-report metadata identify the fresh path.

Wrapper setup rebuilds each variant separately. Both use the same numerical source, workload and compiler options, but the resulting executable bytes are not bit-reproducible. Each wrapper artifact retains its own binary hash.
